name: Vibe Check
description:
# Vibe Check: Secure Your Code Against Invisible Threats

Vibe Check is a specialized security tool designed to protect developers from the growing threat of "Trojan Source" attacks and malicious Unicode obfuscation. In modern development, hidden characters can be used to encode executable payloads that are invisible to the naked eye but lethal to your environment.
